name: Vitruvian Manager data catalogue
description: Every public dataset in Vitruvian Manager (VM, by JDP-Iq), with its fields, size, licence and sources. Read-only; no keys. Files are static JSON on this site; the MCP server (/mcp) and the JSON API (/api/v1/) query them with row and size caps.

datasets.title: Intelligence Briefing: stories
datasets.description: Every story from the Intelligence Briefing's publishers over the last seven days, ten active publishers for each of five political positions (far left to far right). Join `s` to intelligence-briefing-sources for the outlet's name and position.

fields.name: s
fields.description: Source id; join to `id` in intelligence-briefing-sources

fields.name: u
fields.description: Link to the article at its publisher

fields.name: d
fields.description: Standfirst or opening lines from the feed

fields.name: c
fields.description: Soft-news class when the story is not hard news: s sport, e entertainment, l lifestyle; absent for news

datasets.licence: Headlines, standfirsts and links © their publishers, quoted for reference; selection and metadata © JDP-Iq.
sources: RSS and Atom feeds of the publishers listed in intelligence-briefing-sources
Political positions: AllSides Media Bias Ratings, otherwise Media Bias/Fact Check, adjusted to five steps

datasets.title: Intelligence Briefing: publishers
datasets.description: The Intelligence Briefing's publishers with their political position (far left, left, centre, right, far right), country, reliability caution and feed status at the last refresh.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Source id, as used in `s` of intelligence-briefing-stories

fields.name: position
fields.description: Political position: far_left, left, centre, right or far_right

fields.name: caution
fields.description: True when the outlet is rated mixed or low for factual reliability

fields.name: active
fields.description: True when the outlet is one of the ten shown for its position

fields.name: reserve
fields.description: True for a reserve outlet that stands in when an active one fails

fields.name: status
fields.description: Feed status at the last refresh (ok or an error)

fields.name: count
fields.description: Items in the publisher's feed at the last refresh

datasets.licence: Metadata © JDP-Iq; position ratings after AllSides and Media Bias/Fact Check.

Media Bias/Fact Check
The publishers' own feeds

datasets.title: Global Headline Tracker: outlets
datasets.description: The most-read news outlets of each covered country whose front pages the Global Headline Tracker follows, with the feed it reads. datasets.licence: List © JDP-Iq; feeds and articles belong to the outlets.

datasets.title: Geopolitical Volatility: latest scores
datasets.description: The Geopolitical Volatility Index (0–100) for every country on the latest day (2026-10-29), with its five components: conflict & security (35%), political/diplomatic escalation (20%), civil unrest (20%), economic disruption (10%) and cross-border spread (15%). It measures news coverage of events, not events on the ground.

fields.name: score
fields.description: Geopolitical Volatility Index, 0–100 (null when too few events or sources)

fields.name: events
fields.description: GDELT events located in the country that day

fields.name: tone
fields.description: Mean GDELT tone of the coverage (negative is hostile)

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: Coverage level: high, medium or low

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why no score was given, if none

datasets.licence: Index © JDP-Iq (method gvi-1.1); GDELT data free to use with attribution to the GDELT Project.
sources: GDELT 2.0 event exports, all 96 quarter-hour files a day (the GDELT Project)

datasets.title: Digital Briefing: stories and papers
datasets.description: Every paper and story in the Digital Briefing over the last 7 days, classed by fields (ai, software, security, hardware, networks, quantum, privacy, policy) and by type (papers or news). Join `source` to digital-briefing-sources.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Link to the item at its publisher

fields.name: source
fields.description: Source id; join to `id` in digital-briefing-sources

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Kind of source: journal, preprint, lab, research, official, news

fields.name: tier
fields.description: Source tier: 1 Flagship journal; 2 Major journal, lab or agency; 3 Preprint, institute, engineering blog or advocacy; 4 Technology journalism and commentary

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Fields it is classed under (ai, software, security, hardware, networks, quantum, privacy, policy)

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Short summary from the feed (the text remains the publisher's)

fields.name: also
fields.description: Other outlets that carried the same item

datasets.title: Digital Briefing: sources
datasets.description: The journals, preprint servers, institutions and news desks the Digital Briefing reads, with their tier, default fields and feed status.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Feed status at the last refresh

fields.name: count
fields.description: Items in the feed at the last check

fields.name: notModified
fields.description: True when the feed answered "not modified" at the last check (its earlier items are kept)

fields.name: strict
fields.description: True when items matching none of the briefing's fields are dropped (feeds that also carry other subjects)

fields.name: badge
fields.description: Label shown on this source's items instead of its kind (e.g. Opinion)

fields.name: perDay
fields.description: Preprint servers: at most this many new submissions kept from each daily announcement

fields.name: matched
fields.description: Items in the feed that matched the briefing before the daily cap
